name: main-window
summary: The Qt QMainWindow shell (PyMOLQtGUI) hosting the viewport, docks, title tracking session_file, and full-screen toggle.

name: menu-bar
summary: The top menu bar (File/Edit/Build/Movie/Display/Setting/Scene/Mouse/Wizard/Plugin/Help) built from the get_menudata data model via the _addmenu grammar.

name: open-recent-menu
summary: The dynamic File > Open Recent submenu repopulated on aboutToShow from a ~/.pymol/recent.db sqlite store.

name: external-gui-dock
summary: The merged External GUI QDockWidget holding the feedback panel, command line and quick buttons, with a Ctrl+E dockable toggle.

name: command-line
summary: The CommandLineEdit input area (PyMOL> prompt) with Tab/Up/Down/Ctrl+Up/Enter key handling and live drag-and-drop text preview.

name: command-history
summary: The 255-entry command history ring with a slot-0 scratch buffer, dedup on submit, and Ctrl+Up prefix back-search.

name: tab-completion
summary: Command-line Tab completion against command keywords, per-argument auto_arg lists, and filesystem/$ENVVAR glob fallback.

name: feedback-output-panel
summary: The read-only monospace QPlainTextEdit output log, polled every 500ms to drain the feedback queue and sync setting-driven menu items.

name: quick-buttons
summary: The external-GUI shortcut-button grid (Reset/Zoom/Orient/Draw-Ray/Unpick/Deselect/Rock/Get View/transport/Builder/Properties/Rebuild).

name: progress-bar
summary: The external-GUI QProgressBar plus red Abort button (cmd.interrupt), shown/hidden by cmd.get_progress on the feedback tick.

name: splash
summary: The version/copyright splash drawn inside the OpenGL viewport by OrthoSplash, dismissed on first click; there is no Qt splash screen.

name: object-panel
summary: The internal-GUI names list (Executive block): one row per object/selection/all with name button, caption, indent and ASHLC toggles, plus click/drag visibility and reorder semantics.

name: group-control
summary: The group open/close [+]/[-] control at a group row head, logging cmd.group(name, action=open|close) and hosting drag reorder/regroup.

name: A action menu
summary: The per-row A (Action) toggle button opening a type-specific pymol.menu action menu (all_action/sele_action/mol_action/group_action/map_action/etc.).

name: S show menu
summary: The per-row S (Show) toggle button opening the representation show menu (mol_show/cgo_show/map_show/mesh_show/surface_show/etc.).

name: H hide menu
summary: The per-row H (Hide) toggle button opening the representation hide menu, the mirror of the show menu.

name: L label menu
summary: The per-row L (Label) toggle button opening the mol_labels menu (residues/chains/atom name/b-factor/other properties/atom identifiers); absent for map/mesh/surface/slice rows.

name: C color menu
summary: The per-row C (Color) rainbow toggle button opening mol_color (by element/chain/ss/rep/spectrum + full palette) or general/mesh/measurement/slice/vol/ramp color variants.

name: M motion menu
summary: The optional per-row M (Motion) toggle button (present only in 3-Button Motions mode) opening camera_motion or obj_motion for movie key-frame editing.

name: popup-menu-engine
summary: The shared viewport popup-menu engine: [code,text,command] model, hover sub-menu delay, sloppy-mousing, passive/sticky menus, wheel scroll and PLog+PParse commit.

name: movie-control-bar
summary: The 9-button movie transport bar (Control block): rewind/back/stop/play/forward/end plus seq_view, rock and full-screen toggles, with a resize/collapse gutter nub.

name: movie-timeline
summary: The Movie block timeline/scrubber: one ViewElem strip per motion row, a frame scrollbar, and drag gestures for insert/delete/clear/move/copy key frames.

name: butmode-block
summary: The ButMode mouse-mode indicator block: mode name line, optional key/button matrix, selection-mode line, frame-rate line, and click-to-cycle behaviour.

name: wizard-block
summary: The wizard panel block rendering get_panel() text/button/popup lines and dispatching PParse(code) or get_menu(code) on click.

name: wizard-prompt
summary: The floating wizard prompt overlay drawn from get_prompt(), positioned per wizard_prompt_mode (filled box / text only / top-left corner) with color codes.

name: ortho-command-line
summary: The command prompt PyMOL draws inside the viewport (OrthoKey): in-viewport typing, editing chords, history recall and Enter/Esc/Space movie shortcuts.

name: ortho-feedback
summary: The in-viewport feedback/scrollback text (OrthoDrawText) governed by internal_feedback, overlay, overlay_lines, auto_overlay and internal_prompt.

name: selection-indicators
summary: Visual selection cues: parenthesised selection rows with sele_color, the OrthoDrawLoop rubber-band box, and the picking-mode indicator line.

name: scene-bar
summary: The in-scene scene buttons (SceneDrawButtons) stacked bottom-left, gated by scene_buttons, with click-recall, middle-click animate, and right-click reorder/menu.

name: busy-progress-box
summary: The in-viewport busy/progress box (OrthoBusyDraw): a top-left message box with up to two progress bars gated by show_progress.
